paper_id: A Comprehensive Study on Challenges in Deploying Deep Learning Based Software
title: A Comprehensive Study on Challenges in Deploying Deep Learning Based Software
motivation: DL软件部署挑战未被系统研究，与开发阶段不同

method_signature: 3,023 SO帖子 + 769手动标注构建72类挑战taxonomy
evaluation_criteria: 无答案比例、响应时间、挑战类别覆盖率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: DL in browsers is still at dawn，browser问题太少
evidence_for_taste: median response time is about 3 times
questions are more difficult to answer
thinking_moves: 从Q&A社区行为反推技术难度
